N1.s: Τελείωσαν τα %lld δωρεάν cutling. Συνεχίστε στο Cutling για να το ξεκλειδώσετε, και θα αποθηκευτεί κι αυτό.
N1.back: They-ran-out the 5 free cutling. Continue in-the Cutling for to it you-unlock, and will be-saved also this.
N1.why: Opens with K1's "τελείωσαν τα δωρεάν", the Greek way to say a free allowance is used up; Συνεχίστε echoes the vocabulary's Συνέχεια on the system button, and "κι αυτό" points at the item Siri is holding.

N2.s: Τελείωσαν τα %lld δωρεάν cutling. Για κι άλλα, ανοίξτε το Cutling και ξεκλειδώστε το.
N2.back: They-ran-out the 5 free cutling. For also others, open the Cutling and unlock it.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; "κι άλλα" is S2's word for saving more, and the order (open, then unlock) follows what the person will do on a Mac or older iOS.

N3.why: "Μένει ένα" is the spoken "one left"; the item word is dropped as K1 does on the same capsule, and neuter ένα agrees with cutling. 30 characters.

N4.why: Reuses S29's "4 από 5 δωρεάν" pair, so "5 από 5" says the free ones are now full without a second verb; used then total, so plain %lld twice.

N5.why: The pair from N4, which the person saw a save earlier, carries "full"; the rest is the action and its result, with the item as the unspoken subject of αποθηκευτεί. 39 characters, so δωρεάν was the word to drop.

N6.why: The verbal noun Greek iOS buttons use, the same word as S15. 10 characters.

N7.s: Τελείωσαν τα %lld δωρεάν cutling. Ξεκλειδώστε το Cutling και θα αποθηκευτεί κι αυτό.
N7.back: They-ran-out the 5 free cutling. Unlock the Cutling and will be-saved also this.
N7.why: Same opening as N1 and N2; the item is on the form below, so "κι αυτό" needs no noun.

N8.s: Κρατήθηκε για εσάς. Ξεκλειδώστε το Cutling στην εφαρμογή και θα αποθηκευτεί.
N8.back: It-was-kept for you. Unlock the Cutling in-the app and it-will be-saved.
N8.why: Κρατήθηκε is the word a Greek shop uses for something set aside for you; "στην εφαρμογή" says to open Cutling without a second imperative.
